items.hed: Astros beat the Mariners 7-0; Alvarez homered and drove in three
items.insight: MLB.com, Wednesday morning: Yordan Alvarez hit his 41st home run and drove in three runs, reaching 102 RBIs, as Houston beat Seattle 7-0 on Tuesday night at T-Mobile Park. The club said the win snapped a three-game losing streak and moved the Astros (78-79) into a first-place tie in the American League West. Series continues Wednesday in Seattle. Box score stays on the league page.
